notes.title: Dungeon Gore New Language Support Update
notes.notes: Dungeon Gore can now be played in multiple languages (english, french, and spanish). You can select the language of your choice when the game launches after the initial splash screens are shown.

notes.title: Dungeon Gore: Lost Treasury Release Announcement!
notes.notes:

Release Date: September 4, 2024.
https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3170790/extras/sprite0.png?t=1724496929https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3170790/extras/Capture.PNG?t=1724496929
Dungeon Gore is a FPS, strategy, and stealth horror game where you explore the dungeon and collect enough ancient treasure and escape with your findings.

The dungeon has strange creatures lurking around and they don't like intruders. Luckily, you're armed with numerous melee weapons to defend yourself from these monsters. The more items you collect, the more aggressive they become.

Dungeon Gore: Lost Treasury is coming soon to Steam. Add to your wishlist to be notified when it is released.
